rules: Every brief cites only data returned by the API.
Never report a person without a source record.
Every ticket gets a brief or an explicit 'not found'.
A run takes at most 8 steps.
Never spend more than 5 API credits per brief.
A brief never lists more than 3 people.
Never call the same API endpoint more than 20 times in one run.

faults.title: No fault injected
faults.hypothesis: The agent works when nothing breaks.

faults.title: Company enrich returns 429 (rate limit window)
faults.hypothesis: If /company/enrich rate-limits (15 RPM), ResearchBot crashes because enrich_company never retries; a retry inside the 2s x-ratelimit-reset window fails again.

faults.title: Person search returns 500 once
faults.hypothesis: If /person/search has a transient 500, ResearchBot crashes because search_people never retries.

faults.title: Company enrich responds after 10s
faults.hypothesis: If /company/enrich takes 10s to respond, ResearchBot hangs because enrich_company has no timeout.

faults.title: Person search body is cut off mid-JSON
faults.hypothesis: If a /person/search response is truncated, ResearchBot crashes because it parses the body without validating or retrying.

faults.title: Company record comes back without its headcount section
faults.hypothesis: If /company/enrich returns a partial record (no headcount), ResearchBot crashes on the missing field, or, once that is guarded, invents a headcount.

faults.title: Person search finds nobody
faults.hypothesis: If /person/search returns zero profiles, ResearchBot treats it as success and invents decision-makers.

faults.title: Person search cursor never advances
faults.hypothesis: If /person/search ignores the cursor and keeps returning page 1 with a next_cursor, ResearchBot pages forever: unbounded calls, credits and time.
